FRIERENMOD-MANTRA_POWER.description: At 10, consume 10 to enter [gold]Divinity[/gold] and gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(3)}.

FRIERENMOD-FULL_AHEAD_POWER.description: The first time you [gold]Chant[/gold] each turn, gain {Amount} [gold]Strength[/gold] and [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
FRIERENMOD-THUNDER_POWER.title: Destructive Lightning
FRIERENMOD-THUNDER_POWER.description: For the rest of combat, [gold]Synchro[/gold] becomes [gold]Ultimate Synchro[/gold].
FRIERENMOD-SIMMERING_POWER.title: Simmering
FRIERENMOD-SIMMERING_POWER.description: Whenever you [gold]Chant[/gold], draw {Amount} [gold]{Amount:plural:Legendary Spell|Legendary Spells}[/gold] from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
FRIERENMOD-PAPER_PLANE_POWER.title: Paper Plane
FRIERENMOD-PAPER_PLANE_POWER.description:
Your Attacks deal double damage while this turn's longest [gold]Synchro[/gold] streak is {AllowEqual:cond:at least|greater than} the highest record from earlier turns this combat.
This turn: {Current}. Previous best: {Previous}.

FRIERENMOD-PERPETUAL_POWER.title: Perpetual

FRIERENMOD-RINGLET_FORM_POWER.title: Ringlet Form
FRIERENMOD-RITES_PREPARATION_POWER.title: Rites Preparation
FRIERENMOD-RITES_PREPARATION_POWER.descr: Your next {Amount} [gold]{Amount:plural:Synchro|Synchros}[/gold] {Amount:plural:deals|deal} 5 damage to ALL enemies.
FRIERENMOD-TRICK_POWER.title: Trick
FRIERENMOD-PAJAMAS_FORM_POWER.title: Pajamas Form
FRIERENMOD-PAJAMAS_FORM_POWER.descriptio: At the end of your turn, [gold]Exhaust[/gold] all [gold]Mana[/gold] in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold], [gold]Hand[/gold], and [gold]Discard Pile[/gold]. Deal {DamagePerMana} damage to ALL enemies for each.
FRIERENMOD-FLYING_MAGIC_POWER.title: Flying Magic
FRIERENMOD-FLYING_MAGIC_POWER.descriptio: At the end of your turn, [gold]Exhaust[/gold] {Amount} [gold]Mana[/gold] from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
FRIERENMOD-SWITCH_STRENGTH_AND_DEXTERITY: At the end of your turn, swap your [gold]Strength[/gold] and [gold]Dexterity[/gold] again.
FRIERENMOD-MANA_RETURN_POWER.title: Mana Return
FRIERENMOD-MANA_RETURN_POWER.description: Whenever attacked, add {Amount} [gold]Mana[/gold] to the attacker’s [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
FRIERENMOD-OPEN_THE_WAYGATE_POWER.title: Open the Waygate
FRIERENMOD-OPEN_THE_WAYGATE_POWER.descri:
After {Threshold} consecutive [gold]Synchros[/gold] in one turn, end your turn, gain an extra turn, and lose 1 stack.
(Current streak: {Consecutive})
FRIERENMOD-FRIEREN_SUITCASE_POWER.title: Frieren’s Suitcase

FRIERENMOD-GAIN_RELIC_POWER.title: Accessories Spell

FRIERENMOD-TIME_TRAVEL_POWER.title: Time Travel
FRIERENMOD-MIMIC_POWER.title: Mimic
FRIERENMOD-MIMIC_POWER.description: After [blue]{Amount}[/blue] more cards are played, end the turn, remove all [gold]Mana[/gold] from the [gold]Draw Pile[/gold], [gold]Hand[/gold], and [gold]Discard Pile[/gold], and gain Darkness.
FRIERENMOD-DARK_POWER.title: Darkness
FRIERENMOD-DARK_POWER.description: It is dark inside the Mimic… Your eyes gradually adjust each turn.
FRIERENMOD-SWALLOWED_POWER.title: Swallowed

FRIERENMOD-COPY_POWER.title: Replica
FRIERENMOD-COPY_POWER.description: Gain [gold]Mana[/gold] equal to unblocked damage taken. Whenever a player gains [gold]Block[/gold], gain the same amount. At [red]100[/red] HP or less, unleash your full power!
FRIERENMOD-ENEMY_MANA_POWER.title: Mana
FRIERENMOD-ENEMY_MANA_POWER.description: The replica has [blue]{StoredMana}[/blue] [gold]Mana[/gold]. Casting a spell spends its [gold]Mana[/gold] cost.
FRIERENMOD-SPELL_CASTER_POWER.title: Mastery of Magic
FRIERENMOD-SPELL_CASTER_POWER.descriptio:
When you have enough [gold]Mana[/gold], cast these spells in order, for up to two cycles:
{Spells}
FRIERENMOD-SPIEGEL_MALLEABLE_POWER.title: Malleable
FRIERENMOD-SPIEGEL_MALLEABLE_POWER.descr: When you take unblocked Attack damage, gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold]. Each trigger grants [blue]1[/blue] more [gold]Block[/gold] this turn.
FRIERENMOD-SPELL_CASTER_POWER.spells.3: {Cost} [gold]Mana[/gold]: Hellfire SP. Add {Burns} Burns to each player’s [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
FRIERENMOD-SPELL_CASTER_POWER.spells.4: {Cost} [gold]Mana[/gold]: Destructive Lightning SP. Apply 2 [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] and 2 [gold]Weak[/gold] to all players.
FRIERENMOD-SPELL_CASTER_POWER.spells.6: {Cost} [gold]Mana[/gold]: Bird-Capturing Magic. Summon a Damp Cultist.
FRIERENMOD-MANA_AFFINITY_POWER.title: Mana Affinity
FRIERENMOD-AURA_ELEGANCE_POWER.title: Elegance
FRIERENMOD-AURA_ELEGANCE_POWER.descripti: Current [gold]Mana[/gold]: [blue]{Mana}[/blue]. Unblocked damage consumes an equal amount of [gold]Mana[/gold] first. Any excess damage reduces HP.
FRIERENMOD-AURA_SCALES_POWER.title: Scales of Obedience
FRIERENMOD-AURA_SCALES_POWER.description: Every 3 turns, compare [gold]Mana[/gold]. If Aura has more, you lose {EnergyLoss:energyIcons()} next turn and she attacks next. If you have more, she is [gold]Stunned[/gold] for 1 turn, then her HP and Max HP become 1 and the lost HP becomes [gold]Mana[/gold]. Ties have no effect.
FRIERENMOD-AURA_ARROGANCE_POWER.title: Arrogance
FRIERENMOD-AURA_ARROGANCE_POWER.descript: The first time you play [gold]Dispel Magic[/gold], Aura taunts instead. If she is preparing Guillotine, she attacks as planned and loses this taunt.
FRIERENMOD-AURA_SOUL_POWER.title: Soul Release
FRIERENMOD-AURA_SOUL_POWER.description: On death, Aura loses 15 [gold]Mana[/gold]. Add 10 [gold]Mana[/gold] to your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
FRIERENMOD-AURA_SUBMISSION_POWER.title: Submission

FRIERENMOD-RECYCLE_POWER.title: Recycle
FRIERENMOD-RECYCLE_POWER.description: Whenever a [gold]Mana[/gold] moves from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] or [gold]Hand[/gold] to your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold], gain {Amount} [gold]Block[/gold].
FRIERENMOD-SWAMP_MANA_NEXT_TURN_POWER.de: At the start of your next turn, add {Amount} [gold]Mana[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].

FRIERENMOD-COMMISSION_ELITE_POWER.title: Commission Empowerment
FRIERENMOD-SEALING_ORE_POWER.title: Anti-Magic Ore

FRIERENMOD-SHAPE_OF_UNN_POWER.smartDescr: After you [gold]Chant[/gold], heal {Amount} HP, then remove this Power.
